text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having successfully cast her ultimate racing magic, Sweep Tosho decides she doesn't need to run anymore. Instead, she starts studying a completely different kind of magic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, after recovering from an injury, a certain Umamusume from the Triple Tiara tour supposedly distances herself from racing after a fateful practice run with Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It turns out the real reason is that she fell into despair after comparing herself to the racers competing at the Takarazuka Kinen. According to her, anyone who gets injured and takes time off gets left behind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho is outraged at her for accepting "the way things are" and makes a heated vow to cast some magic on her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We set her next goal as the autumn Tenno Sho, and ask her special rival, Zenno Rob Roy, to enter the race too.
